# Code map

Where code lives. Each entry is the first sentence of the file's header comment; grep for symbols.

## Rust crates

A crate's contract is the full `//!` header of its `lib.rs` or `main.rs`.

### `uniwrt-core` (crates/core)

Shared vocabulary of every uniwrt crate: IDs, MAC and IP types, timestamps and the `Clock` trait.

- `src/clock.rs`: The wall clock as an injected dependency, so time-dependent code is deterministic in tests.
- `src/id.rs`: Typed integer IDs: one newtype per entity, so a node ID can never be passed as a job ID.
- `src/lib.rs`: Shared vocabulary of every uniwrt crate: IDs, MAC and IP types, timestamps and the `Clock` trait.
- `src/mac.rs`: MAC addresses (EUI-48): lenient parsing, canonical formatting and the address bits that matter.
- `src/time.rs`: Timestamps: Unix milliseconds in UTC, with saturating arithmetic and RFC 3339 display.

### `uniwrt-model` (crates/model)

The uniwrt domain model: what the controller observes on nodes and what it records about them.

- `src/facts/capabilities.rs`: Detected capabilities: what rendering and the agent may rely on (ARCHITECTURE.md, principle 4).
- `src/facts/interface.rs`: Logical interfaces (netifd) and the kernel network devices beneath them.
- `src/facts/mod.rs`: Observed facts: everything one collection round of the node agent reports about a node.
- `src/facts/radio.rs`: Radios (UCI `wifi-device`, kernel phy), what their hardware supports, and their interfaces.
- `src/facts/station.rs`: Associated stations (Wi-Fi clients and mesh peers): signal, rates, traffic and capabilities.
- `src/facts/system.rs`: Board identity, the firmware release and resource usage (`system board`, `system info`).
- `src/lib.rs`: The uniwrt domain model: what the controller observes on nodes and what it records about them.
- `src/node.rs`: The inventory record of an adopted node: identity, management address, role and mode.
- `src/wifi.rs`: Wi-Fi vocabulary: bands, channel widths and 802.11 standards, named as OpenWrt names them.

### `uniwrt` (crates/server)

The `uniwrt` binary: CLI, configuration and composition root; serves the API and the web UI.

- `build/civil.rs`: Dependency-free UTC date formatting, shared by the build script and the crate's unit tests.
- `build/main.rs`: Build script: the build identity (`meta`) and the embedded web UI (`ui`), written to `$OUT_DIR`.
- `build/meta.rs`: Build identity: `$OUT_DIR/build_info.rs` with the version, commit, build time and target.
- `build/ui.rs`: Embeds the web UI: every file plus brotli and gzip variants, and a lookup table sorted by path (`$OUT_DIR/ui.rs`, included by `src/ui/assets.rs`).
- `src/build_info.rs`: Build identity from build/meta.rs: the version and commit (injected by CI), the build time and the target triple.
- `src/cli.rs`: Command-line interface.
- `src/healthcheck.rs`: `uniwrt healthcheck`: `GET /api/v1/health` on the local server; success means a 200.
- `src/http/health.rs`: `GET /api/v1/health`: liveness plus the build identity.
- `src/http/mod.rs`: The HTTP surface: `/api` routes, the embedded UI as the fallback, and the middleware both share.
- `src/http/problem.rs`: API errors as RFC 9457 problem details (`application/problem+json`).
- `src/http/security.rs`: Security headers on every response (features/security.md): a strict CSP, no framing, no MIME sniffing, no referrers and same-origin isolation.
- `src/logging.rs`: Logging: `tracing` to stderr, filtered by `--log` / `UNIWRT_LOG` (`EnvFilter` syntax).
- `src/main.rs`: The `uniwrt` binary: CLI, configuration and composition root; serves the API and the web UI.
- `src/serve.rs`: `uniwrt serve`: starts the runtime, opens the database, binds the listener and serves until SIGTERM or SIGINT.
- `src/ui/assets.rs`: The asset table: one entry per UI file, each with optional brotli and gzip variants.
- `src/ui/encoding.rs`: `Accept-Encoding` negotiation (RFC 9110 §12.5.3) over the variants an asset has.
- `src/ui/mod.rs`: The embedded web UI: the asset table generated by build/ui.rs, `Accept-Encoding` negotiation and the SPA fallback.
- `src/ui/respond.rs`: Answers a UI request with an embedded file, the SPA page for a client-side route, or a 404.
- `src/version.rs`: `uniwrt version`: build information as text or JSON.

### `uniwrt-store` (crates/store)

SQLite persistence: one database in WAL mode, a batching writer thread, a read pool and repositories.

- `src/codec.rs`: Column encodings shared by the repositories: enums as serde names, MACs as canonical text, timestamps as Unix milliseconds, and constraint violations as the domain errors they mean.
- `src/connection.rs`: Opening connections: the private database file, the writer's pragmas and migrations, readers.
- `src/error.rs`: Store errors: opening and migrating, domain outcomes (conflict, not found) and failed writes.
- `src/lib.rs`: SQLite persistence: one database in WAL mode, a batching writer thread, a read pool and repositories.
- `src/migrate.rs`: Forward-only schema migrations, embedded at build time and tracked in `PRAGMA user_version`.
- `src/readers.rs`: The read pool: read-only connections, opened on demand, used on tokio's blocking pool.
- `src/repo/facts.rs`: [`FactsRepo`] on SQLite: the `node_facts` table, one JSON snapshot per node.
- `src/repo/mod.rs`: Repository traits: the store's API by concern.
- `src/repo/nodes.rs`: [`NodeRepo`] on SQLite: the `nodes` table.
- `src/store.rs`: The store handle: opening with migrations, reads through the pool, writes through the writer.
- `src/testing.rs`: Test support: a fresh store in a temporary directory, on a manual clock.
- `src/writer.rs`: The writer: one thread owns the only write connection and commits queued operations in batches.

## Web UI (`web/src`)

Files per directory. Tests sit next to the code as `*.test.ts[x]`; `test/` holds the shared setup.

- top level: index.css, main.tsx
- `api/gen/`: TypeScript types generated from Rust DTOs by `just gen` (1 file); never edit
- `app/`: App.tsx, HealthBadge.tsx, NotFound.tsx, SectionPage.tsx, Shell.tsx, Sidebar.tsx, ThemeToggle.tsx, TopBar.tsx, nav.ts, routes.tsx
- `lib/`: api.ts, strings.ts, theme.ts
- `ui/`: EmptyState.tsx, Wordmark.tsx, tokens.css

## Scripts

- `scripts/check.sh`: Runs everything CI gates on, one line per step (`just check`).
- `scripts/crate-age.sh`: Lists the crates that Cargo.lock adds or changes against a git revision (default: HEAD), with their crates.io publish dates, and fails if any is younger than the 7-day cooldown (D-029).
- `scripts/cross.sh`: Builds static musl binaries with cargo-zigbuild inside its container, so the host needs only Docker.
- `scripts/gen-map.sh`: Regenerates docs/MAP.md, the code map: each Rust file with the first sentence of its `//!` header, the web UI's directories and the scripts.
- `scripts/next-version.sh`: Prints the next release version from the Conventional Commits since the last vX.Y.Z tag (D-008), or nothing when HEAD is already released.
- `scripts/next-version.test.sh`: Tests scripts/next-version.sh against throwaway git repositories; `just check` and CI run it.
